# GreyhoundIQ

> Australian greyhound racing intelligence platform. Real-time race cards, full career form, breeding analytics, and AI predictions for punters, breeders, trainers, and owners across all Australian states. Not a wagering service.

GreyhoundIQ covers active greyhound racing venues across every Australian state and territory, with a national database of 200,000+ greyhounds and millions of historical race results. The platform provides real-time race cards, full career form with sectional times, multi-generation pedigrees, sire statistics, track-bias analysis, and machine-learning race predictions. Free tier gives full racing data access; Pro ($20 AUD/month or $204 AUD/year) adds marketplace listings, messaging, custom pages, and community tools.

## Key pages

- [About](https://greyhoundsiq.com.au/about): Platform background, data sources, and team
- [Pricing](https://greyhoundsiq.com.au/pricing): Free and Pro subscription tiers (AUD)
- [Tracks](https://greyhoundsiq.com.au/tracks): Australian greyhound racing venues with form and box-bias data
- [Dogs](https://greyhoundsiq.com.au/dogs): Search the national greyhound database by name, ear brand, or trainer
- [Races](https://greyhoundsiq.com.au/races): Live and historical racecards, runners, results, and replays
- [Breeding](https://greyhoundsiq.com.au/breeding): Sire statistics and breeding analytics for Australian greyhounds
- [Statistics](https://greyhoundsiq.com.au/statistics): Box bias, trainer leaderboards, track records, and speed maps

## Coverage

States covered: New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland, South Australia, Western Australia, Tasmania, Northern Territory, ACT.

## Licensing and responsible use

Race and results data is sourced from official Australian racing feeds. Analytics, predictions, and platform content are copyright GreyhoundIQ. GreyhoundIQ provides form and analytics only — no odds and no wagering. 18+ only.
